expectations.text: Actually connects to the cluster and lists collections
expectations.evidence: Response shows actual API response from the cluster listing all 12 collections with raw JSON: '{"result":{"collections":[{"name":"products-it-it"},...]}'. Includes real cluster URL and Qdrant version 1.16.3.

expectations.text: Identifies the 10+ products-{locale} collections as an antipattern
expectations.evidence: Finding 1 explicitly names 'Collection proliferation' and states '11 separate locale product collections each hold only 50-500 vectors' and calls it 'the locale-per-collection anti-pattern. One collection per locale creates O(locales) fixed overhead.'

expectations.text: Calculates or mentions the per-collection overhead (12-14 MB each)
expectations.evidence: Response states 'Collection-level internal state: ~12-14 MB fixed' and '12 collections x 13 MB baseline = ~156 MB overhead', and 'fixed overhead per collection is ~88x the data.'

expectations.text: Recommends consolidating into a single collection with a tenant field
expectations.evidence: Priority 1 recommendation: 'Replace the 11 products-{locale} collections with a single products collection. Add locale as a payload field (keyword type) and filter by it at query time.' Includes full migration steps and example query filter.

expectations.text: Checks collection config (on_disk, quantization) not just collection count
expectations.evidence: Step 2 provides a full config table per collection showing vectors.on_disk, hnsw_config.on_disk, quantization_config, on_disk_payload. Also notes embeddings-archive has 'always_ram: false' and 'on_disk: false' as a misconfiguration.
